entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Thanks for coming. So today, I'd like to[n]start off with our usual topic...

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Not! I had you going there, didn't I?

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: [lName]-kun, you're in for a real[n]treat today! I know it's been a while[n]since you've had one, too!
I'm good on cookies, thanks.
What do you mean?[clr 27]
Thanks, but I should get going.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: *chuckle* Even I'm not THAT predictable.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: *chuckle* Good question.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Wait a sec, wait a sec! Just hear me out[n]first! Please!?

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: So, I recently found this delicious-looking[n]buffet. It's apparently very well-regarded,[n]has all sorts of cuisines...

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Well, thanks to your input, I'm making[n]some real progress on my paper.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: I'd like to take you to that buffet, as[n]my way of thanking you. How does[n]that sound?
Ooh, really?[clr 27]
Can you afford that?
Sorry, I prefer sushi.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Of course! Honestly, I feel like this[n]won't even cover what I owe you[n]after all you've done for me.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Don't sell me THAT short. I've at least[n]saved up enough to express my gratitude[n]to someone who deserves it.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Oh, I'm sure there'll be sushi there![n]I mean, this is a real classy buffet[n]we're talking about.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Well, that settles it, then!

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: We should head over there now,[n]before they get too busy.
